decisions.statement: A seat's scope holds no process of its own once this has run.
Every process the scope held moves into one child of that scope.
Processor time and memory are turned on for that scope's children.
A run the seat starts is then made inside the seat rather than beside it.
A group that is no seat's scope is left alone.
A scope opened already is left as it is.
A seat's scope is known by the name tmux gives it.
Whether the controllers came on is read back rather than assumed.
A seat whose scope would not open works on as that seat did before.
Nothing here ends a process or reads what one spent.

definition: the group a seat's own processes sit in, apart from the runs that seat starts
